successCriteria.description: Define the `Employee` interface in `src/modules/employee/employee.model.ts` with all specified attributes: `id: string`, `employeeNumber: string`, `firstName: string`, `lastName: string`, `email: string`, `managerId: string | null`, `department: string | null`, `hireDate: Date`, `terminationDate: Date | null`, `employmentStatus: EmploymentStatus`, `createdAt: Date`, `updatedAt: Date`, `deletedAt: Date | null`. Import `EmploymentStatus` from `src/shared/types/index.ts`.

Define `IEmployeeRepository` interface extending `IBaseRepository<Employee>` with additional methods: `findByEmployeeNumber(employeeNumber: string): Promise<Employee | null>`, `findByEmail(email: string): Promise<Employee | null>`, `findByManagerId(managerId: string): Promise<Employee[]>`, `findActive(): Promise<Employee[]>`.

Implement `EmployeeRepository` class implementing `IEmployeeRepository` using the pg pool from `src/shared/db/connection.ts` with parameterized SQL queries for all methods: `findById`, `findAll`, `create`, `update`, `delete`, `findByEmployeeNumber`, `findByEmail`, `findByManagerId`, `findActive`.
Create Jest unit tests in `tests/unit/modules/employee/employee.repository.spec.ts` with mocked pg pool, covering `findById`, `findByEmployeeNumber`, `findByEmail`, `create`, and `update`.

constraints: All SQL queries must use parameterized queries ($1, $2, etc.) — no string interpolation or concatenation of user-supplied values into SQL.
Repository must use the pg pool from `src/shared/db/connection.ts` for all database access (GP-001: all database access through repository pattern).
Soft-delete pattern: `delete` method sets `deleted_at = NOW()`; all read queries filter `deleted_at IS NULL`.
No circular dependencies between modules — employee module imports only from `src/shared/`, never from other domain modules.
outOfScope: Employee service, controller, or routes — these are deferred to later phases (Phase 5+).
Employee DTOs (CreateEmployeeDto, UpdateEmployeeDto) — not specified in this phase's deliverables.
Database migrations for the employees table — deferred to Phase 10.
Integration tests — only unit tests with mocked pg pool are in scope for this phase.
Audit record writing (GP-002) — repository layer does not write audit records; that is a service-layer concern deferred to later phases.
RBAC enforcement (GP-005) — no API endpoints exist in this phase.
Input validation at API boundaries (GP-003) — no API boundaries exist in this phase.

ambiguities.description: Test file naming convention: the intent specifies `tests/unit/modules/employee/employee.repository.spec.ts` but the existing test file in the project uses the `.test.ts` suffix (`employee.repository.test.ts`). Jest recognizes both patterns by default. The code-agent must decide whether to create a new `.spec.ts` file (potentially duplicating the existing `.test.ts`) or to treat the existing `.test.ts` as the target.
options: Create a new `employee.repository.spec.ts` file alongside the existing `employee.repository.test.ts`
Treat the existing `employee.repository.test.ts` as the canonical test file and skip creating a new `.spec.ts`
Rename the existing `.test.ts` to `.spec.ts` to match the intent
